summary: Backend testing of P0 driver-approval flow, auth guard for pending users, immediate trip deletion (cleanup_expired_trips), and admin batch deletion endpoints. Wrote pytest suite (10 tests) hitting the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. All 10 tests passed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~1010 lines — approaching the 700-line guideline threshold. Consider splitting into modules (auth, trips, reservations, admin) for maintainability.

cleanup_expired_trips uses a module-level `_cleanup_running` boolean lock; this is per-process only. In multi-worker deploys concurrent cleanups may still run — acceptable since operations are idempotent, but worth documenting.

POST /api/trips does not validate that date/time is in the future. Any driver can publish a trip in the past which is then instantly cleaned up. Not a bug (we relied on it for testing) but might merit a 400 validation for real users.

admin_delete_user cascades many collections (trips, reservations, chats, notifications, reports) sequentially; batch operations are used but there is no transaction — a partial failure could leave orphan data. Consider adding try/except with logging.
test_credentials: Used credentials from /app/memory/test_credentials.md (admin@borajunto.com/admin, giovanna@example.com/123456, magobranco322@gmail.com/123456). Ad-hoc TEST_* users created and cleaned up.
seed_data_creation: None persisted. All TEST_-prefixed users/trips created during tests are removed via admin_delete_user in teardown or by the cleanup_expired_trips (past-date trip).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pytest suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_approval_flow.py and covers: driver register→pending, passenger immediate token, login-blocked 403, GET /admin/pending admin-only, approve→login OK, reject→bloqueado, /auth/me guard for pendente & bloqueado, immediate trip deletion after past date (both /api/trips and /api/admin/trips trigger cleanup), admin DELETE /admin/users batch (3 trips + reservation notification), admin DELETE /admin/trips notification for confirmed passenger. Reservation endpoint is POST /api/reservations with {trip_id}. Notifications endpoint is GET /api/notifications.
